pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-sided dark regions with high edge angularity; the gradients between dark and light pixels are sharp despite sensor resolution limits; patches on the lower neck exhibit a fragmented, stellate-like geometry.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with multiple trifurcated junction nodes; pixel thickness varies, narrowing significantly between the large patches on the shoulder and lower neck area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour against the background along the superior neck line.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, localized cluster of pixels forming a distinct silhouette of an avian symbiont is situated on the dorsal ridge of the neck, obscuring a portion of the mane's edge profile.
